profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer @ Atlassian
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer/Architect focused on efficiency, quality, design, and user experience. Enjoys working on complex technical problems regardless of technology or domain. Builds software to accommodate tomorrow without sacrificing today. Thrives in a flexible work environment with a relaxed team that is interested in comradery. Strengths include high attention to detail, rapid, quality engineering and development, being a bridge between stakeholders, and the ability to lead and coach others.

positions.locationName: Dardenne Prairie, Missouri, United States · Remote

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked with the Confluence Cloud Ecosystem team to support and bring new extensibility capabilities available for 2p Atlassian Marketplace developers.
• Served as tech lead for the Confluence dark mode project - bringing light and dark themes to all Confluence users and assisting app developers in the support of themes in their apps.
• Drove new team support process improvements to reduce team burden and resolve internal and external developer support requests faster.
• Led test migration efforts for migrating e2e tests from Webdriver to Cypress/Puppeteer and later to Playwright in order to reduce test flakiness, increase developer productivity, and work toward a more ideal testing pyramid.

positions.title: Co-Owner & Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Website consulting
• Manage business operations


--- US Wide Financial ---
www.uswidefinancial.com
• Architected service-oriented system supporting a complex mortgage broker website
• Designed & Implemented Spring Boot microservices using MySQL; Ember.js web-app
• Deployed and hosted applications using Helm, Docker, and k8s on GCP allowing for a highly scalable website
• Designed CI/CD Pipelines with Jenkins and Git-Flow to optimize limited engineering capacity and reduce human error
• Collaborated with business, UX/UI designer, and content editor regularly to balance product and engineering needs
• Coached junior engineers into self-sustaining contributors

positions.title: Principal Consultant, Application Architect
positions.description:
• Successfully delivered engineering & architecture excellence to several product teams across multiple clients
• Served as a senior team manager and career advisor to dozens of consultants helping grow their careers and navigate team dynamics
• Provided technical interviews of potential new hires
• Spearheaded Daugherty open-source initiatives to foster teamwork within Daugherty, give back to the open-source community, and strengthen the Daugherty brand
• Created and delivered technical training to other consultants and clients
• Experience in a UX role


--- Edward Jones ---
• Served as engineering delivery lead and established engineering discipline, best practices, and pragmatic financial advisor product development
• Architected and implemented the product using Spring Boot, React, Redux, Mongo, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Unleash, and Jenkins creating a stable and scalable product
• Championed balanced, pragmatic software testing based on the testing pyramid allowing for rapid regression testing and yielding near-zero production issues
• Influenced cultural change in agile development, testing, and DevOps

positions.title: Principal Consultant, Software Engineer III
positions.description:
--- Bayer Crop Science ---
• Served as a senior software engineer to build a product to support new business model using cloud-native infrastructure with AWS Serverless, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, PostgreSQL RDS, Fargate and React/Redux
• Designed and implemented Jenkins CI/CD, releasing small increments to production multiple times per week – constantly shipping the latest value to customers
• Led coordination and implementation design with critical external systems - each presenting unique challenges – and successfully integrated under a limited time constraint
• Assisted in product management, design, and strategy which kept the team operating more efficiently

--- RGA ----
• Led effort to assess migration effort and strategy for a product from AngularJS to ReactJS
• Defined strategy and estimated effort/timeline by evaluating various aspects of the product current and future state
• Successfully delivered formal report/presentation leading to future PoC efforts

positions.title: Senior Consultant, Software Engineer III
positions.description:
--- Contegix ---
• Assumed tech lead, architect, project manager, and team manager roles
• Designed, implemented, and guided other software engineers in building a suite of Java/Groovy Spring Boot microservices backed by Mongo, a TypeScript React/Redux web-app, Keycloak SSO, Gitlab, Ansible, and Docker
• Managed teams to successful sprints, demos, and product benchmarks on time and under budget
• Collaborated directly with product stakeholders on product/engineering roadmap and priorities to create the most value with limited budget
• Designed and implemented Jenkins pipelines building, testing, deploying, and releasing product artifacts, optimizing engineering workflow

--- Finlocker ---
• Served in an engineering leadership role for a personal finance product
• In a short time on the project, introduced and coached the team in Angular unit testing, improved DevOps maturity, and assisted the team in architecture

positions.title: Consultant, Software Engineer II
positions.description:
--- RGA ---
• Served as the primary resource for front-end development on a new automated underwriting product. Integrated several 3rd party dependencies, made front-end architecture decisions, assisted clients with product integration, and provided AngularJS, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, Bootstrap, NodeJS, npm, Webpack, and Jenkins guidance to the rest of the development team
• Developed Groovy/Grails web services backend and championed RESTful API patterns; backed by Oracle
• e2e functional test automation using Geb on Selenium

positions.title: Consultant, Software Engineer I
positions.description:
--- Export to China ---
• Designed/Developed single page responsive web application for Export-To-China.com using EmberJS and Bootstrap
• Developed and utilized RESTful web services written with the Spring Framework backed by MySQL

--- AEP River Operations ---
• Analyzed & documented barge logistical processes
• Coordinated with dozens of stakeholders across multiple companies utilizing BargeEx EDI

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on military-contracted software using C++, C#, WPF, and Java
• Developed R&D Applications on Android devices
• Designed & Implemented User Interfaces
• Utilized ESRI Mapping technology
• Agile/Scrum Master experience

positions.description: Provided support for campus websites. Developed tools and products for the University websites.

projects.title: RGAx AURA Hackathon - 2nd place
projects.description:
fReMarket (Facultative Underwriting Marketplace)

Worked as a software engineer and web designer for the 2nd place team at RGAx AURA Blockchain Hackathon (Team Ball and Blockchain) Helped design workflows and implemented responsive web front-end using AngularJS, Bootstrap, and Font Awesome.Built with webpack, continuously deployed with Docker/Docker Cloud.
